newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zeitler - EMU stability pact must have legal force.
newsitem.headline: Zeitler - EMU stability pact must have legal force.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said on Monday he believed the proposed stability pact for the planned single European currency should be given legal backing by European nations.
Zeitler said it was important European Union nations give legal backing to the stability pact, agreed last year in Dublin, when they hold a summit in Amsterdam scheduled for July.

He also reaffirmed his support for strict interpretation of the Maastricht Treaty, which contains guidelines for membership in the new currency set to begin in January 1999, saying that "lasting fulfilment" of the criteria was critical.
"The real, strict and believable fulfilment of the stability and trust criteria and their requirements are in the own best interest of every member state," Zeitler said in the text of the speech.
